_comment: RCS reaction/tapback. Arrives as an ordinary NEW inbound content://mms row (ct_cls=135) whose body is a synthesized localized string: '<emoji> to "<quoted target text>"' (the real device also wraps the emoji in zero-width spaces). It does NOT modify or structurally reference the target row, so it is classified as a normal received message. A processor may optionally pattern-match this body shape to attach it to the quoted message.

expected.note: captured as a normal received message; not structured reaction metadata
